entry.title: From Mandate to Verified Outcome: An Evaluation Framework for Autonomous Agent Execution
entry.summary: A technical evaluation framework for testing whether consequential autonomous-agent execution remains continuously bound to an accountable human or institutional mandate through runtime authorization, execution, external state change, independent verification and outcome receipt.
entry.content: Margelis Research Note 001, version 1.1. Status: Concept + Evaluation Framework. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22806682.
